analysis_type: Static review of the packaged library and title call site, with TuxBox factory and flag controls

title_import.name: D3D12XboxSetProcessDebugFlags
title_import.caller_observation: Passes either 1 or the value in a title field, then checks the returned HRESULT sign.

reference_behavior.set: Masks flags with 0x83f00001, stores the result in process-global state, and returns 0.
reference_behavior.d3d12_create_device: Builds a zeroed 72-byte 0x20004 creation record. It fills DWORD 1 with the process debug flags and DWORDs 2, 6, and 7 with UINT32_MAX, then calls D3D12XboxCreateDevice at RVA 0x1570.

tuxbox_provider.implementation: The standard-named factory returns a guest device through the 0x20004 Xbox creation path. The getter and setter use masked process-local atomic state. Factory tests exercise default release flags.
